d: Short, chestnut brown hair with straight-cut bangs and a soft texture. Small, narrow golden eyes behind oversized silver-rimmed glasses, featuring a neutral and reserved expression. A youthful appearance with a slender build. The outfit consists of a white collared shirt with a black tie, layered under a white cardigan with orange and green accents and a small circular gold pin, paired with high-waisted, wide-leg brown plaid trousers, a dark belt, and chunky grey sneakers. Signature details include a vintage grey portable computer held in one arm and several white and blue cables extending from the back of the trousers.
